defs.d: The fruit of the date palm, Phoenix dactylifera, somewhat in the shape of an olive, containing a soft, sweet pulp and enclosing a hard kernel.
defs.ex: We made a nice cake from dates.

defs.d: The date palm.
defs.ex: There were a few dates planted around the house.

defs.d: Something done so as to accomplish a purpose.
A way of motion or functioning.
defs.ex: Knead bread with a rocking action.

defs.d: To act on a request etc, in order to put it into effect.
To initiate a legal action against someone.
Demanding or signifying the start of something, usually an act or scene of a theatric performance.
defs.ex: The director yelled ‘Action!’ before the camera started rolling.

defs.d: Any period of 24 hours.
defs.ex: I've been here for two days and a bit.

defs.d: A period from midnight to the following midnight.
defs.ex: The day begins at midnight.

defs.d: To spend a day (in a place).
To resolve (a contest, problem, dispute, etc.); to choose, determine, or settle
defs.ex: Her last-minute goal decided the game.

defs.d: To make a judgment, especially after deliberation
defs.ex: I have decided that it is healthier to walk to work.

defs.d: A situation in which the king is directly threatened by an opposing piece.
An inspection or examination.
defs.ex: I don't know if she will be there, but it's worth a check.

defs.d: Brand or kind; model.
defs.ex: What make of car do you drive?

defs.d: Manner or style of construction (style of how a thing is made); form.
To create.
To behave, to act.
defs.ex: He made as if to punch him, but they both laughed and shook hands.

defs.d: Having relevant and crucial value.
defs.ex: It is very important to give your daughter independence in her life so she learns from experience.

defs.d: Pompous; self-important.
A visual representation of an area, whether real or imaginary.
A graphical representation of the relationships between objects, components or themes.
To create a visual representation of a territory, etc. via cartography.
(followed by a "to" phrase) To act as a function on something, taking it to something else.
Something actual as opposed to invented.
defs.ex: In this story, the Gettysburg Address is a fact, but the rest is fiction.

defs.d: Something which is real.
defs.ex: Gravity is a fact, not a theory.

defs.d: Used before making a statement to introduce it as a trustworthy one.
The act of flying.
defs.ex: Most birds are capable of flight.

defs.d: An instance of flying.
defs.ex: The migrating birds' flight took them to Africa.

defs.d: (of a spin bowler) To throw the ball in such a way that it has more airtime and more spin than usual.
(by extension) To throw or kick something so as to send it flying with more loft or airtime than usual.
Fast, swift, fleet.
Honorific alternative letter-case form of him, sometimes used when referring to God or another important figure who is understood from context.
A male person.
defs.ex: I think this bird is a him, but it may be a her.

defs.d: A masculine pronoun; he as a grammatical object.
Used reflexively: (to) himself.
An act of thinking; consideration (of something).
defs.ex: I'll have a think about that and let you know.

defs.d: To ponder, to go over in one's head.
defs.ex: Idly, the detective thought what his next move should be.

defs.d: To communicate to oneself in one's mind, to try to find a solution to a problem.
defs.ex: I thought for three hours about the problem and still couldn’t find the solution.

defs.d: Straight, not bent.
defs.ex: a right line

defs.d: Of an angle, having a size of 90 degrees, or one quarter of a complete rotation; the angle between two perpendicular lines.
defs.ex: The kitchen counter formed a right angle with the back wall.

defs.d: To put under the influence of a spell; to affect by a spell; to bewitch; to fascinate; to charm.
To read (something) as though letter by letter; to peruse slowly or with effort.
(sometimes with “out”) To write or say the letters that form a word or part of a word.
To work in place of (someone).
defs.ex: to spell the helmsman

defs.d: To rest (someone or something), to give someone or something a rest or break.
defs.ex: They spelled the horses and rested in the shade of some trees near a brook.

defs.d: Elongated portion.
Connected sequence of people or things.
To practice an ability.
defs.ex: She trained seven hours a day to prepare for the Olympics.

defs.d: To teach and form (someone) by practice; to educate (someone).
defs.ex: You can't train a pig to write poetry.

defs.d: A wheeled vehicle, generally drawn by horse power.
A passenger car, either drawn by a locomotive or part of a multiple unit.
To train.
To instruct; to train.
defs.ex: She has coached many opera stars.

defs.d: A general fact or proposition; a generality.
defs.ex: We have dealt with the generals; now let us turn to the particulars.

defs.d: The holder of a senior military title, originally designating the commander of an army and now a specific rank falling under field marshal (in the British army) and below general of the army or general of the air force in the US army and air forces.
To lead (soldiers) as a general.
Including or involving every part or member of a given or implied entity, whole etc.; as opposed to specific or particular.
(sometimes postpositive) Applied to a person (as a postmodifier or a normal preceding adjective) to indicate supreme rank, in civil or military titles, and later in other terms; pre-eminent.
A digital option.
Digital equipment or technology.
defs.ex: He moved to digital for the first time, using a Sony camera.

defs.d: Having to do with digits (fingers or toes); performed with a finger.
Property of representing values as discrete, usually binary, numbers rather than a continuous spectrum.
defs.ex: digital computer;  digital clock

defs.d: A female monarch. Example: Queen Victoria.
The wife or widow of a king.
To make a queen.
To act the part of a queen; to queen it.
Any of the manners by which living beings perceive the physical world: for humans sight, smell, hearing, touch, taste.
Perception through the intellect; apprehension; awareness.
defs.ex: a sense of security

defs.d: To use biological senses: to either see, hear, smell, taste, or feel.
To instinctively be aware.
defs.ex: She immediately sensed her disdain.

defs.d: A state of tranquility, quiet, and harmony; absence of violence. For instance, a state free from civil disturbance.
defs.ex: Our lounge strives to maintain an environment of peace for the comfort of our customers.

defs.d: A state free of oppressive and unpleasant thoughts and emotions.
defs.ex: The safety equipment will give me some peace of mind.

defs.d: To make peace; to put at peace; to be at peace.
To peace out.
Shut up!, silence!; be quiet, be silent.
Shortened form of peace out; goodbye.
Various sounds, usually unwanted or unpleasant.
defs.ex: He knew that it was trash day, when the garbage collectors made all the noise.

defs.d: Sound or signal generated by random fluctuations.
To make a noise; to sound.
To spread news of; to spread as rumor or gossip.
One who has a position of authority in a hierarchical organization, especially in military, police or government organizations.
A respectful term of address for an officer, especially a police officer.
To supply with officers.
To command like an officer.
(usually a mass noun) Lodging in a dwelling or similar living quarters afforded to travellers in hotels or on cruise ships, or prisoners, etc.
(physical) Adaptation or adjustment.
The interior of a building; the space inside buildings generally.
defs.ex: I prefer the indoors to the outdoors.

defs.d: In or into a building.
defs.ex: We stayed indoors to avoid the brutal heat.

defs.d: One which receives or entertains a guest, socially, commercially, or officially.
defs.ex: A good host is always considerate of the guest’s needs.

defs.d: One that provides a facility for an event.
To perform the role of a host.
defs.ex: I was terrible at hosting that show.

defs.d: To lodge at an inn.
Disbelief or uncertainty (about something); a particular instance of such disbelief or uncertainty.
defs.ex: I have doubts about how to convert this code to JavaScript.

defs.d: A point of uncertainty; a query.
To be undecided about; to lack confidence in; to disbelieve, to question.
defs.ex: He doubted that was really what you meant.

defs.d: To harbour suspicion about; suspect.
To put (something) down, to rest.
defs.ex: Set the tray there.

defs.d: To attach or affix (something) to something else, or in or upon a certain place.
defs.ex: I have set my heart on running the marathon.

defs.d: To divide a class group in a subject according to ability
The time, place and circumstance in which something (such as a story or picture) is set; context; scenario.
The act of setting.
defs.ex: the setting of the sun

defs.d: A modifier key whose main function is shifting between two or more functions of any of certain other keys (usually by pressing Shift and the other button simultaneously).
A type of women's undergarment, a slip.
defs.ex: Just last week she bought a new shift at the market.

defs.d: A change of workers, now specifically a set group of workers or period of working time.
defs.ex: We'll work three shifts a day till the job's done.

defs.d: (sometimes figurative) To move from one place to another; to redistribute.
defs.ex: We'll have to shift these boxes to the downtown office.

defs.d: To change in form or character; swap.
A sequence of states representing an encoded message in a communication channel.
Any variation of a quantity or change in an entity over time that conveys information upon detection.
To indicate; to convey or communicate by a signal.
To communicate with (a person or system) by a signal.
defs.ex: Seeing the flames, he ran to the control room and signalled headquarters.

defs.d: Standing above others in rank, importance, or achievement.
defs.ex: a signal exploit; a signal service; a signal act of benevolence

defs.d: The amount, number or rate of something, regarded as part of a total of 100; a part of a whole.
defs.ex: A high percentage of secondary school leavers take a gap year.

defs.d: A share of the sales, profits, gross margin or similar.
defs.ex: She gets a percentage for every vacuum cleaner sold.

defs.d: A formalized choice on matters of administration or other democratic activities
defs.ex: One occasion indicative votes were used was in 2003 when MPs were presented with seven different options on how to reform the House of Lords.

defs.d: An act or instance of participating in such a choice, e.g., by submitting a ballot
defs.ex: The Supreme Court upheld the principle of one person, one vote.

defs.d: To cast a vote; to assert a formalized choice in an election
defs.ex: Did you vote last month?

defs.d: To choose or grant by means of a vote, or by general consent
defs.ex: The depository may vote shares on behalf of investors who have not submitted instruction to the bank.

defs.d: (stative) To perceive sounds through the ear.
defs.ex: I was deaf, and now I can hear.

defs.d: (stative) To perceive (a sound, or something producing a sound) with the ear, to recognize (something) in an auditory way.
defs.ex: I heard a sound from outside the window.

defs.d: The sense used to perceive sound.
defs.ex: My hearing isn't what it used to be, but I still heard that noise.

defs.d: The act by which something is heard.
Able to hear.
defs.ex: Deaf people often must deal with hearing people.

defs.d: Indefinitely large numerically, many.
defs.ex: There are numerous definitions of the word 'man'.

defs.d: To launch a projectile.
To move or act quickly or suddenly.
The result of launching a projectile or bullet.
defs.ex: The shot was wide off the mark.

defs.d: The act of launching a ball or similar object toward a goal.
defs.ex: They took the lead on a last-minute shot.

defs.d: To load (a gun) with shot.
A vast space.
Very large or wide (literally or figuratively).
defs.ex: The Sahara desert is vast.

defs.d: Very great in size, amount, degree, intensity, or especially extent.
